analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: We may use or share these groups, ad IDs, and insights with other brands to provide more tailored offers and ads, enhanced experiences, and campaign measurement.

analysis.headline: Shares with Ad Networks
analysis.quote: We and our advertising partners serve you ads about other companies tailored to your interests.

analysis.headline: Collects Sensitive Health Data
analysis.quote: Some types of data we collect could also be considered consumer health data, as that term is sometimes broadly defined.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: This may include information about your physical or biological characteristics (like face scans and voiceprints) where they are used to identify you.

analysis.headline: Trains AI with Your Data
analysis.quote: We use personal data to provide, develop, customize, and personalize products and services, including to train artificial intelligence models (e.g., to improve our network, enhance customer service, etc.).

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: If you provide your permission, we may also use your precise location for advertising purposes, to provide location-based services like SyncUP KIDS, or other services.

analysis.headline: Accesses Your Text Messages
analysis.quote: We collect the following categories of sensitive personal data (as defined under certain state privacy laws): your Social Security number... what’s in your text messages...

analysis.headline: Tracks You In Stores
analysis.quote: Some of our retail stores may have technology that tracks aggregate traffic patterns and wait times using Wi-Fi and Bluetooth identifiers.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track Your Web Activity
analysis.quote: We may allow third parties (e.g., Google) to place technology on our websites (e.g., a cookie or a pixel) that allows them to track you. The third party might also collect data over time and across other websites.

analysis.headline: Uses Your CPNI for Ads
analysis.quote: We also may use or share certain CPNI with your opt-in consent, including for our Tailored Offers and Ads and Product Development programs available in our Privacy Dashboard.
